title: DuctWafDTO
description: DuctWafDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

wafDeterminationDate.description: The date the WAF applied in column 20 was determined.

wafBeginDate.description: The date on which the WAF was first applied to the flow rate data.

wafBeginHour.description: The hour in which the WAF was first applied to the flow rate data.

wafMethodCode.description: Code used to identify the WAF determination method.

wafValue.description: The WAF applied to the flow rate data, to four decimal places.

numberOfTestRuns.description: The number of runs in the WAF test (must be one for default WAF and at least three for a measured WAF)

numberOfTraversePointsWAF.description: The number of Method 1 traverse points in the WAF test runs.

numberOfTestPorts.description: The number of test ports at which measurements were made during the WAF test runs.

numberOfTraversePointsRef.description: The number of Method 1 traverse points in the reference flow RATA test runs.

ductWidth.description: The width of the rectangular duct at the test location.

ductDepth.description: The depth of the rectangular duct at the test location.

wafEndDate.description: The date on which the WAF was last applied to the flow rate data.

wafEndHour.description: The hour in which the WAF was last applied to the flow rate data.

id.description: Unique identifier of a rectangular duct WAF data record.

locationId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring location record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.
